Emerging Sovereign Group LLC Has Lowered Its Position in New Oriental Ed & Tech Grp I (EDU) as Market Value Declined Posted by Pearl Odom on December 8, 2018 at 7:06 pm
Emerging Sovereign Group Llc decreased its stake in New Oriental Ed & Tech Grp I (EDU) by 16.12% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Emerging Sovereign Group Llc sold 108,691 shares as the company’s stock declined 32.12% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 565,517 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $53.53M, down from 674,208 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Emerging Sovereign Group Llc who had been investing in New Oriental Ed & Tech Grp I for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $9.13 billion market cap company. (NYSE:EDU) has declined 23.32% since December 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.94% the S&P500.
